clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
Determining the scope of the ISMS
Actions to address risks and opportunities — General
Segregation of duties
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization has sufficient staff to segregate conflicting duties. May be partially applicable in very small organizations — compensating controls must be documented.

clauses.title: Information security in project management
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization runs projects. Not applicable only if the organization has no project-based work within the ISMS scope.

clauses.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
Information security in supplier relationships
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization uses suppliers who access, process, store or manage its information or ICT infrastructure. Not applicable only if no such suppliers exist.

clauses.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.5.19 is applicable. Requires formal agreements with relevant suppliers.

clauses.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization uses ICT products or services from a supply chain. Not applicable if all ICT is internally developed and maintained with no external components.

clauses.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.5.19 is applicable.

clauses.title: Information security for use of cloud services
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization uses any cloud services. Not applicable only if no cloud services are used within the ISMS scope.

clauses.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
Assessment and decision on information security events
ICT readiness for business continuity
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization has defined ICT continuity requirements based on business continuity objectives. Depth scales with criticality of ICT to operations.

clauses.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
Privacy and protection of personal identifiable information (PII)
Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
Information security awareness, education and training
Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
Remote working
clauses.condition: Applicable if any personnel work remotely or from locations outside the organization's controlled premises. Not applicable only if all work is exclusively on-site.

clauses.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
Working in secure areas
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization has defined secure areas with restricted access. Not applicable if no secure areas exist within the ISMS scope.

clauses.title: Security of assets off-premises
clauses.condition: Applicable if any equipment or assets are used or stored off-premises. Not applicable only if all assets remain exclusively on-site at all times.

clauses.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
Access to source code
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization develops or maintains software. Not applicable if the organization has no software development activity within the ISMS scope.

clauses.title: Data masking
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization processes personal data or sensitive information requiring masking (e.g. for testing, analytics). Not applicable if no such processing exists.

clauses.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization has availability requirements for its information processing facilities. Depth scales with criticality of systems to operations.

clauses.title: Installation of software on operational systems
Segregation of networks
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization operates multiple networks or network segments requiring separation. Not applicable if the organization has a single flat network with no segregation requirement.

clauses.title: Web filtering
clauses.condition: Applicable if personnel have access to external websites during work. Not applicable only if internet access is fully blocked for all users within the ISMS scope.

clauses.title: Secure development life cycle
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization develops software or systems internally. Not applicable if the organization has no in-house development activity.

clauses.title: Application security requirements
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.8.25 is applicable, or when the organization procures externally developed applications.

clauses.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.8.25 is applicable.

clauses.title: Secure coding
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.8.25 is applicable and the organization writes code.

clauses.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.8.25 is applicable.

clauses.title: Outsourced development
clauses.condition: Applicable if any software or system development is outsourced. Not applicable if all development is fully in-house.

clauses.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
clauses.condition: Applicable when A.8.25 is applicable and the organization maintains separate environments. Not applicable if no development environments exist.

clauses.title: Test information
clauses.condition: Applicable if the organization uses real or production-derived data for testing. Not applicable if testing uses only synthetic or anonymized data.

clauses.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
